title: Smithing Chisels
description: This texture pack replaces the current vanilla Smithing Templates with Chisels (and a hammer for the Netherite template)
body:
I've always thought the Smithing Templates were uninspired, and very bland. I liked the idea that you could feel more rewarded by seeing something interesting when you obtain something collectible like this. For that, I turned all the Smithing Templates into different chisels, all with unique textures.

![Every texture changed, displayed on a board](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/82d9db9338fe41c15c10bebaf5b39c27c64618f7.png)

The chisels are all designed to fit where they appear in the game, or be somewhat consistent with what is presented to the player alongside it's obtainability.

Feel free to use this whereever! Just please please please give me credit. This is my first time uploading a texture pack publicly, and I'd love to keep making more!
